purpose: Matched forward-playback compositor cost/capacity observations, not renderer adoption or smoke-art acceptance.

method.order: Sorted/default/provisioned in repetition 1, reverse in repetition 2; workload/resolution order unchanged.
workloads: saved persistent-smoke candidate show with audience camera and representative-only lighting
four coincident saved smoke-cohort roots with existing high-tier lighting policy
modes: OIT average 4 / sorted 32 / 128 MiB explicit host provisioning
method.host_interval: Absolute deadlines; missed deadlines retained and reported; no skipped player frames.
method.native_simulation_ticks: Recorded independently; up to 2 observed fixed ticks per simulation window, not one native tick per host update.
method.initialization: Normal forward advancement, shader-readiness wait and paused diagnostic warmup outside measurement. No seek/replay.
method.cost_lane: OIT aggregate diagnostics disabled; standard async GPU timestamps enabled.
method.capacity_lane: Independent app and identically initialized forward playback with bounded aggregate scans enabled. No timing from this lane is used as production-cost evidence.
method.async_caveat: Own timestamp/sequence deduplication, not frame-ID join; startup/final messages may straddle the measurement boundaries. Peak populations are async counts. No raw particle/fragment transport.
method.timing_scope: Whole render-graph scope includes simulation and rendering but not host preparation/game/audio/presentation. app.update duration is not GPU completion time. Do not sum pass/source percentiles.
method.remaining_scope: 4-second high-tier window, not the full show/finale, other GPUs/tiers or HDR/bloom. External desktop/overlay activity is not controlled.

decision.reason: All 2828 fresh capacity observations exceed the local exact-sort threshold, even at sorted_max=32, despite zero global drops/invalid links. Default 32 MiB storage rejects 1080p. Memory/performance provisioning alone does not establish dense compositing correctness.
decision.next: F8.1C4M: dense overflow image-error oracle, then correct premultiplied alpha/additive overflow representation/order handling or select another bounded compositor; rerun matched cost/capacity before adoption.

raw_reports: One JSON per case, plus accepted.json, under native_run.root. This committed evidence preserves selected timing/metadata/capacity values and SHA256 of every raw report. Raw reports additionally contain full GPU pass/source timing distributions.
harness_iteration: Initial fixture unit compile used a nonexistent root.clips member; corrected to compiled project dependencies before native measurements. No native measurement from that compile failure is accepted. No timing/capacity threshold was weakened.
warnings: Vulkan Galaxy overlay manifest/registry notices, repeated-headless-app LogPlugin/global-subscriber warnings and no-tonemapping/dither notices occurred during app setup. Pending-pipeline counts are zero inside every measured window; these notices are not shader-composer failures. Existing incremental hard-link fallback notices remain environmental.
